lead: Towers facing the sea and a large park: the newest neighbourhood on the coast, born with the 2004 Fòrum.
text: It arose from the urban plan for the 2004 Universal Forum of Cultures, on fourteen hectares, part of which the park now occupies, that had belonged to the Can Girona company. It takes its name from its position at the start of Avinguda Diagonal, next to the Mediterranean, and it is one of the newest neighbourhoods in Barcelona.

It is a residential neighbourhood of towers, such as Illa de la Llum, Illa del Bosc and Illa del Cel, with the Parc de Diagonal Mar and the Llevant beach as its great open spaces. At 5,528 €/m² and 1,732 €/month, it has the highest sale price and rent in Sant Martí.
housing: Towers and new-build residential buildings, beside the sea.
